lines.text: Every AI scribe can write a note. It lands in the chart, and at the next visit, you start over.
Stream writes the visit the way you'd chart it with time to spare: subjective and objective, then assessment and plan, split out by problem.
Each plan joins its problem's thread. Next visit, you see what you decided, and update only what changed.
Follow-ups you say out loud, like “recheck the A1c in three months,” become tasks under that problem. No second entry.
